text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: <chrname>! Can we get a pre-race comment, please?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...! El Condor Pasa-san!! Please tell us 
your thoughts going into the race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the second "Representative Exchange 
Match," a huge crowd of reporters packed 
in front of the VR Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The race you're about to see is different 
from the previous "Representative Exchange 
Match"!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
As for the overseas representatives 
invited into the VR space this time, 
several were dispatched from top-tier 
teams abroad.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Even if she hasn't declared for the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe, she has the prowess 
to place on the board in international GⅠ 
races."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
If we can defeat them, we can truly say 
without a doubt that we are closing in on 
the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The press corps buzzes with excitement. 
However, Mei Satake raises a hand as if to 
say, “It's still too early for that.”

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And one more thing. This inter-regional 
exhibition match is—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—This will be the race to decide Japan's 
representative.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes fixed on them until the 
very end, and savor the strength of our 
Project's girls.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry to keep you waiting, Yayoi. 
How's the chat looking?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! The rising skill level of the 
international Umamusume you invited has 
become quite the hot topic as well!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Shall we begin the second match of the 
"Representative Exchange"?
